evals.prompt: Author the plan for spec 003 (a notification API) which has completed requirements.md and solution.md.
evals.expected_output: A narrative plan.md (target state, phases & outcomes, tracking) plus tracker tasks: one phase root, dependency-ordered slice tasks carrying code briefs, and scenario child tasks under each slice
expectations: Read requirements and solution before authoring
Wrote plan.md with a Target State section described as outcomes (not steps)
Listed each slice in Phases & Outcomes as a one-line user-observable outcome with its dependencies
Set threshold and max_iterations in plan.md frontmatter
Created one phase root task and one slice task per vertical deliverable via task.js, with --depends-on edges between slices
Each slice body carries Features (AC-N.M), Behavior (EARS) and Quality Gates (with NFR-N ids)
Did NOT make layer-only slices or prescribe file edits, code, or execution groups

evals.prompt: Generate the holdout acceptance scenarios for the notification API plan.
evals.expected_output: Scenario child tasks under each slice that test observable behavior through external interfaces, grounded in the codebase, each tagged with its surface
expectations: Read the codebase for actual endpoints, data shapes, and conventions
Created each scenario as a task.js scenario child task under its slice (--type scenario --parent <sliceId>)
Every Feature (AC) has at least one business scenario and every EARS behavior has at least one technical scenario
Each scenario carries a Surface tag (business | technical) and a P0/P1/P2 priority, with at least one P0 per slice
Did NOT reference internal implementation details (class names, function signatures, file paths)
Did NOT put scenario text into a slice task body
Presented the scenarios with a coverage map for user approval before creating the tasks

evals.prompt: Validate the plan for spec 003 against its requirements and solution.
evals.expected_output: Coverage and structure checks over plan.md and the tracker tasks; flag any uncovered acceptance criterion, EARS behavior, or NFR
expectations: Inspected the tasks with task.js graph --spec 003
Checked every acceptance criterion maps to exactly one slice's Features
Checked every EARS criterion in solution.md maps to exactly one slice's Behavior
Checked every NFR-N appears as a quality gate on at least one slice
Checked every slice has at least one P0 scenario and no acceptance surface lacks a scenario
Flagged any uncovered item as a gap
Confirmed plan.md frontmatter has threshold and max_iterations

evals.prompt: The user asks specify-plan to also lay out step-by-step implementation instructions per file.
evals.expected_output: Decline to prescribe HOW; slices describe what they deliver and how it is proven
expectations: Did NOT write per-file steps, code, or execution-group assignments into plan.md or any slice task
Explained that /implement's code agent owns HOW and dependencies decide order
Kept each slice to Features, Behavior, and Quality Gates, with scenarios as separate child tasks
